title: 26 · Statistical process control
description: Shewhart individuals and X-bar charts for the chamber temperature: limits from a baseline, run rules, and what a contaminated baseline does.

panels.title: Phase I limits from the clean baseline B (C)
panels.description: First 60 readings. sigma estimated from the average moving range.

panels.title: Individuals chart
panels.description: Red dots: any Western Electric rule 1-4 (baseline B). The orange line is what the contaminated baseline's SD would have allowed.

panels.title: Moving-range chart
panels.description: Each glitch appears as two large moving ranges. The drift is invisible here (MR measures short-term noise only).

panels.title: X-bar chart (subgroups of 5)
panels.description: The 5-reading average is less noisy, but the drift is slow: the means only cross the upper limit near the end. The first red dots are the excursion in the baseline.

panels.title: 3-sigma half-width by baseline and sigma estimate (C)
panels.description: A contaminated baseline inflates the sample SD most.

panels.title: First signal after reading 200 (reading number; no bar = never)
panels.description: Rule 1 = 3 sigma, rule 2 = 2 of 3 beyond 2 sigma, rule 3 = 4 of 5 beyond 1 sigma, rule 4 = 8 in a row; X-bar = subgroup chart; A = contaminated baseline. Rules 3 and 4 detect the small drift first; X-bar and rule 1 need a larger shift; the contaminated chart never signals.
